title: Picture is misleading but item is okay
text: Picture is misleading but item is okay. I really wanted what was shown in the picture- 2 small (square-shaped) bins and a larger, longer bin.  I received 3 longer, oblong-shaped bins!  Okay, it was not such a crisis and I made do.  The color (peach) is excellent, soft and feminine.  The finish is a little rough, reminding me of burlap.  However, the bins are strong, easily assembled and will last.  I am not using them for lingerie as the texture might snag something dainty'

product_metadata.title: mDesign Fabric Dresser Drawer and Closet Storage Organizer Bin for Bedroom - Holds Lingerie, Bras, Socks, Leggings, Clothes, Purses, Scarves, Jane Collection, Set of 3, Cantaloupe/White
